candidates.name: White Cable-Knit Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: Only a narrow product form is shown. The sharply tapered waist, slim sleeves and tight tall neck offer no credible relaxed worn fit and risk the dated skinny Winter Office silhouette being removed.

candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Mock-Neck Sweater
candidates.decisionReason: The saturated blue is welcome, but the product-only image depicts an artificially muscle-sculpted, skin-tight mock neck with a long tapered torso and no reliable drape proof.

candidates.name: Beige Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only source does not prove shoulder, torso or sleeve ease, while beige would produce a washed-out neutral board with the required camel coat rather than the requested happier winter color.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Textured Henley Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The clean henley idea is useful, but only a product form exists; worn fit, knit recovery and hem behavior are unproven, and the khaki tone would repeat the planned camel layer.

candidates.name: Dusty-Blue Corduroy Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The dusty blue brightens the palette, but the long open-over-tee body, cap styling and lightweight shirt construction read mild-weather Casual or Travel rather than a warm self-contained Winter Office top.

candidates.name: Steel-Blue Fine-Knit Crew
candidates.decisionReason: The listed peacock color actually reads dusty steel blue, while the narrow shoulder, close torso, tight sleeves and long ribbed hem repeat the dated skinny-knit shape.

candidates.name: Camel Cable-Knit Quarter-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: The dense cable has Winter substance, but the close arms and torso, bulky high zip neck and camel-on-camel direction feel dated and muddy rather than modern colorful Office.

candidates.name: White-and-Black Grid Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The relaxed grid can serve Casual or Travel, but the overshirt depends on a separate base layer and its graphic black-white pattern lacks the warm fine-gauge polish required for Mid-Range Winter Office.

candidates.name: Army-Green Corduroy Wide-Leg Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only image cannot prove rise, thigh or drape and shows a balloon-taper corduroy leg with rolled cuffs. It is too dark and uncertain for the required warm-ivory controlled Office trouser.
